metadata.description: A working flow for Claude Code as versioned plugins: a personal knowledge wiki, session conventions, a prompt audit, a change walkthrough, session handoffs, a live board of your story chains, a fixed model ladder and a coordinator for stories across repos

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: A personal knowledge wiki in plain markdown: save fixes and notes, recall them by topic or symptom, lint the vault, drain the inbox

plugins.name: session-discipline
plugins.description: Working-session conventions you adopt into your own CLAUDE.md as a managed block, and a decision-interview skill

plugins.name: prompt-audit
plugins.description: Mine your own Claude Code prompt history for what you keep asking by hand, and turn the repeats into rules in your own CLAUDE.md

plugins.name: walkthrough
plugins.description: Understand a branch, a pull request or a pasted diff by predicting it before reading it: a quiz graded against the code, findings where the code deviates, and the checks to run by hand

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Close a session so the next one starts cold: land green work, write the pick-up block, draft the next session's prompt, record the close in the story file; plus away and back

plugins.name: board
plugins.description: A live board of your story chains: a card per story (running, needs you, stalled, done), its FOR ME steps with ticks that persist, its MR links; /where and /forme in text

plugins.name: ladder
plugins.description: A fixed model ladder for handoff closes: a kind -> model/effort table you edit, defaults from your plan, and an effort gate that asks before a max launch once you turn max on

plugins.name: coordinate
plugins.description: Turn a session into the coordinator of a story across repos or branches: plan worker sessions from a mission doc, start them through handoff, route their reports, keep one status board
